grammar.title: 可以表示“变成”的一些动词
lines: "grow," "turn," "go," "get," "come," 和 "fall" 在表示“变成”的不同用法，get 、become 、turn 、go、 grow 当翻译为“变得” 时，为系动词。 By 的5种用法 §
动词 用法示例 解释

grow He has grown fat. Leaves grow green in spring. My interest in art has grown. He has grown to like studying mathematics. He grew angry when I told him about it. grow dark（变黑） 表示逐渐或渐变成某种状态。可指自然生长或兴趣、感情等的发展。 grow = get slowly 慢慢变得

turn Leaves will turn yellow in autumn. The leaves are turning yellow. His face turned red. She turned her hobby into a career. A colony of bees had turned the engine into a hive. 表示将某物改变成某种状态，或是改变颜色。可用于叶子变黄、脸变红，也可表示将兴趣、爱好变成事业。
go Some foods go bad easily. The milk went sour. This apple has gone bad. Things got so bad that he went on a diet. 表示不好的变化，通常指食物变坏或状态恶化。也可表示一下子变得，如天气突然变冷。

get She got sick last week. They got married last year. Coal got scarce last winter. Things got so bad recently that he decided to go on a diet. 表示逐渐变成某种状态，通常强调变化的过程。可用于描述生病、结婚等情况。 在口语中使用较多，表示“成为（某种状态）”，强调的是变化的过程（一下子变得）。天气变化，一般用 get，get cold(变冷)

come Her dream to swim across the channel has come true. The dream comes true. 梦想成真 Take it easy; everything will come right. The knot came loose. 变松动 表示实现某种状态或梦想，如梦想成真。也可表示事物状态的变化，如结的变松。 可表示“变成，成为，达到”等，与 true 连用时表示“实现” come + true/right/loose
fall You fell asleep while I was talking. He fell ill last week. Prices fell significantly. 表示逐渐或突然变成某种状态，如入睡、生病或价格下跌。 fall + asleep/ill 坠落梦乡/病倒了
'I've just arrived by train,' she said. 通过...方式(by doing)、方法。
It was bought by my grandfather . 被动语态 + by 表被谁做
They told stories and sang songs by the campfire . 在... 旁边 §
Workers will have completed the new roads by the end of this year . By + 时间：截止到，搭配“完成成”
It cleared the mountain by 400 feet . 相差额度：增长了、下降了、增加了、减少了，体现中间浮动变化差额
